misconceptions.description: Spending limited sprint time on colors and fonts before fixing a broken formula, link, or data error
misconceptions.trigger: learner restyles the page while a #REF! error or dead link remains
misconceptions.feedback: Triage by impact. In a time box, fix correctness errors (broken formula, dead link, wrong total) before any cosmetic change. A pretty page with a #REF! still fails.

misconceptions.description: Making many edits during the sprint without recording what changed, so the work cannot be reviewed or reverted
misconceptions.trigger: learner saves over the file repeatedly with no timestamped log of edits
misconceptions.feedback: Keep a short changelog: time, what changed, and why. It lets a reviewer trace the sprint and lets you roll back a change that made things worse.

misconceptions.description: Starting a full rebuild in the middle of a short revision sprint instead of making targeted fixes
misconceptions.trigger: learner deletes the working artifact to start over with 20 minutes left
misconceptions.feedback: A sprint revises, it does not rebuild. Make the highest-impact targeted edits the time allows, and note larger rework as a future item rather than starting from scratch.
